name: Cancel without the event
description: Ada cancels her booking for an event that has since been taken off sale. She is still refunded and the booking still goes, but the seats are never put back: cancel-booking writes the event row only when there is an event, and nothing on the diagram says that write is conditional.

trigger.description: Ada presses cancel on a booking for an event that is no longer on sale.

trace.description: The page itself knows nothing about refunds, so the press becomes a request and the page waits for the sentence it will show.

response.message: Cancelled booking gig-10: 112.5 is on its way back.

trace.description: The server hands the request straight to the block that answers it, which is the seam between the code Fragmentor checks and the code that receives real requests.

response.message: Cancelled booking gig-10: 112.5 is on its way back.

trace.description: Nothing can be refunded until the booking is found, and a missing booking would end the run here with a refund of nothing.
The event is looked up because its seat count is what a cancellation would give back. This is the run where that lookup finds nothing.
The event row is asked for by id, and the table no longer has one: the event was removed while this booking was still outstanding.
The refund is worked out from the booking alone, so a missing event takes nothing away from what the person gets back: 50 paid, less 2 for each of the 2 seats.

The booking goes whether or not the event is still there. What a reader should notice is the step that is not here: on the run where the event exists, the event row is written back with the seats on sale again, and nothing on the diagram says that write was conditional.
The booking is gone from the table, and no event row changed anywhere in this run.
The caller is told the booking is cancelled and what is coming back. Nothing in the answer says the event had vanished, so the person sees the ordinary cancellation message.

detail.message: Cancelled booking gig-10: 112.5 is on its way back.

trace.description: The page shows the message it was given, which is all the state it keeps.

detail.showing: Cancelled booking gig-10: 112.5 is on its way back.
